ASSET: Sweet Home 3D / Scopia "Hydrangea" (hydrangea) - flowering bush with 3 flower balls
CATEGORY: vegetation -> SM_FlowerBush_Blue (hydrangea_blue), SM_FlowerBush_White (hydrangea_white); hydrangea_pink = original colour.
          0.8 x 0.8 x 0.65 m as authored -> scale ~x1.8 for the 1.2 m catalog bush.
